from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_counts = Counter(tuple(row) for row in grid)
    common_row = row_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if tuple(row) != common_row]

    col_signatures = [
        tuple(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)
    ]
    common_col = Counter(col_signatures).most_common(1)[0][0]
    col_bounds = [c for c, col in enumerate(col_signatures) if col != common_col]

    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    interior_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r not in row_bounds]
    node_baseline = Counter(
        grid[r][c] for r in interior_rows for c in col_bounds
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            r1, r2 = row_bounds[i], row_bounds[i + 1]
            c1, c2 = col_bounds[j], col_bounds[j + 1]
            corners = [
                grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2],
                grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]
            ]
            if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 and corners[0] != node_baseline:
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(base)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    common_row = Counter(tuple(row) for row in grid).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if tuple(row) != common_row]

    col_signatures = [tuple(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    common_col = Counter(col_signatures).most_common(1)[0][0]
    col_bounds = [c for c, sig in enumerate(col_signatures) if sig != common_col]

    interior_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r not in row_bounds]
    interior_cols = [c for c in range(w) if c not in col_bounds]

    base = Counter(
        grid[r][c] for r in interior_rows for c in interior_cols
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    node_values = [
        grid[r][c] for r in interior_rows for c in col_bounds
    ]
    node_baseline = Counter(node_values).most_common(1)[0][0] if node_values else 0

    active_rows = [
        i for i, r in enumerate(row_bounds)
        if any(grid[r][c] != node_baseline for c in col_bounds)
    ]
    active_cols = [
        i for i, c in enumerate(col_bounds)
        if any(grid[r][c] != node_baseline for r in row_bounds)
    ]

    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return [[base]]

    rows = row_bounds[active_rows[0]:active_rows[-1] + 1]
    cols = col_bounds[active_cols[0]:active_cols[-1] + 1]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            if corners[0] != node_baseline and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
